title: 一般现在时与现在进行时
summary: 分清「习惯、事实」与「此刻、这段时间正在发生」，口语 Part 1 谈日常、写作描述现状时时态不出错。

sections.heading: 一般现在时：习惯、事实与长期状态
sections.body:
一般现在时说的是**经常发生的事、长期状态和普遍事实**，不强调「此刻」。

主语是第三人称单数（he / she / it、单数名词、不可数名词）时，动词要加 -s 或 -es；否定和疑问借助 does，后面的动词回到原形。口语 Part 1 被问到 Do you work or are you a student? 这类问题，回答的主干时态就是一般现在时。

head: 形式
结构
例子
rows: I / you / we / they + 动词原形；he / she / it + 动词-s
She teaches maths. / Water boils at 100 degrees.
Do / Does + 主语 + 动词原形?
Does your city have a metro?
一般加 -s；以 s、x、ch、sh、o 结尾加 -es；辅音字母 + y 变 y 为 i 再加 -es

examples.en: I usually take the bus to university because parking is expensive.
examples.cn: 我通常坐公交去大学，因为停车太贵。
examples.note: usually 表习惯；parking 是不可数名词，谓语用 is。

examples.en: My hometown has a population of about two million.
examples.cn: 我的家乡大约有两百万人口。
examples.note: 长期事实用一般现在时；my hometown 是单数，用 has。

examples.en: Most teenagers spend several hours online every day.
examples.cn: 大多数青少年每天上网好几个小时。
examples.note: every day 是典型的习惯标志词。

sections.heading: 现在进行时：此刻、这段时间与变化趋势
sections.body:
现在进行时由 **am / is / are + 动词-ing** 构成，表示说话这一刻正在发生的动作，也可以表示**最近一段时间在做、但此刻不一定在做**的事，以及**正在发生的变化**。

雅思写作和口语谈社会变化时常用最后一种：More and more people are working from home. 强调这是一个正在发生的趋势。

head: 用法
常见标志词
例子
rows: now, right now, at the moment, Look! / Listen!
Sorry, I'm cooking dinner at the moment.
this week, this term, these days, currently
I'm preparing for the IELTS test this term.

examples.en: I'm reading a book about climate change at the moment.
examples.cn: 我最近在读一本关于气候变化的书。
examples.note: 不一定此刻手里拿着书，表示这段时间在做。

examples.en: More and more students are choosing to study abroad.
examples.cn: 越来越多的学生选择出国留学。
examples.note: 描述正在发生的趋势。

examples.en: Listen! Someone is knocking at the door.
examples.cn: 听！有人在敲门。
examples.note: Listen! / Look! 提示动作此刻正在发生。

sections.heading: 怎么选：长期习惯还是暂时情况
sections.body:
判断的关键是**长期 / 习惯**还是**暂时 / 正在进行**。同一个动词换个时态，意思就变了：I live in Beijing. 是长期住在北京；I'm living in Beijing. 暗示暂时住在这里，以后可能搬走。

口语里把「平时」和「最近」放在一起对比，听起来更自然，也能体现时态的准确度。

head: 一般现在时
现在进行时
rows: I work in a bank.（长期工作）
I'm working in a bank this summer.（暂时）
She usually walks to work.（习惯）
She's taking the train this week because her bike is broken.（这周例外）
Prices are rising quickly.（正在发生的变化）

examples.en: I normally study in the library, but this week I'm studying at home because the library is closed.
examples.cn: 我平时在图书馆学习，但这周图书馆关门，我在家学。
examples.note: normally 配一般现在时，this week 配现在进行时。

examples.en: My brother lives in Shanghai, but he's staying with us for a few days.
examples.cn: 我哥哥住在上海，不过这几天他住在我们家。

sections.heading: 状态动词一般不用进行时
sections.body:
有一类动词表示**状态**而不是动作，比如喜好、想法、感知、拥有，一般**不用进行时**。即使说的是此刻，也用一般现在时：I know the answer now.

少数状态动词表示「动作」意思时可以用进行时，例如 think 表「考虑」、have 表「吃、度过」：I'm thinking about changing my job. / We're having lunch.

head: 类别
常见状态动词
rows: like, love, hate, prefer, want, need
know, believe, understand, mean, remember, agree
see, hear, seem, smell（闻起来）, taste（尝起来）
have（拥有）, own, belong to, contain, consist of

examples.en: I understand why many people prefer online shopping.
examples.cn: 我理解为什么很多人更喜欢网购。
examples.note: 不说 I'm understanding。

examples.en: This report contains data from twenty countries.
examples.cn: 这份报告包含二十个国家的数据。

examples.en: I'm thinking about taking a gap year before university.
examples.cn: 我在考虑上大学前休学一年。
examples.note: think about 表「考虑」，是动作，可以用进行时。

pitfalls.wrong: My father work in a hospital.
pitfalls.right: My father works in a hospital.
pitfalls.why: 主语是第三人称单数，一般现在时的动词要加 -s。中文动词没有词形变化，写快了最容易漏。

pitfalls.wrong: She doesn't likes coffee.
pitfalls.right: She doesn't like coffee.
pitfalls.why: 已经用了 doesn't，后面的动词回到原形，不能再加 -s。

pitfalls.wrong: I am knowing the answer.
pitfalls.right: I know the answer.
pitfalls.why: know 是状态动词，表示「知道」这种状态，不用进行时。

pitfalls.wrong: I am usually get up at seven.
pitfalls.right: I usually get up at seven.
pitfalls.why: 把中文「我是……」直译成 am，造成 be 动词和实义动词并用。一般现在时的肯定句不需要 am / is / are。

pitfalls.wrong: Look! The children play in the rain.
pitfalls.right: Look! The children are playing in the rain.
pitfalls.why: Look! 提示动作此刻正在发生，要用现在进行时。

exercises.q: My sister ___ for a software company, but this month she ___ from home.
exercises.explain: 前半句说长期工作，用一般现在时，主语是第三人称单数要加 -s；this month 表示暂时情况，用现在进行时。

exercises.q: Water ___ (freeze) at zero degrees Celsius.
answer: freezes
exercises.explain: 客观事实用一般现在时；water 是不可数名词，按单数处理，动词加 -s。

exercises.q: Please be quiet. The baby ___ (sleep).
answer: is sleeping
exercises.explain: 说话这一刻正在发生的动作，用 is + 动词-ing。

exercises.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I am believing that technology makes life easier.
I believe that technology makes life easier.
I believing that technology makes life easier.
exercises.answer: I believe that technology makes life easier.
exercises.explain: believe 是表示想法的状态动词，不用进行时；第三项缺少谓语动词。

exercises.q: He don't usually eat breakfast.
answer: He doesn't usually eat breakfast.
He does not usually eat breakfast.
exercises.explain: 主语 he 是第三人称单数，否定要用 doesn't，后面的动词用原形。

exercises.q: These days more and more young people is moving to big cities.
answer: These days more and more young people are moving to big cities.
These days, more and more young people are moving to big cities.
exercises.explain: people 是复数，be 动词用 are；these days + 趋势用现在进行时。

title: 一般过去时与过去进行时
summary: 用一般过去时讲清过去发生的事，用过去进行时交代背景，口语 Part 2 讲经历时时态稳定、叙事有层次。

sections.heading: 一般过去时：已经结束的过去动作
sections.body:
一般过去时表示**过去某个时间发生并且已经结束**的动作或状态，常和 yesterday、last year、in 2019、two days ago、when I was a child 等明确的过去时间连用。

口语 Part 2 很多话题要求描述一次经历，主干时态就是一般过去时。否定和疑问借助 did，后面的动词回到原形。

head: 形式
结构
例子
rows: We visited a science museum last weekend.
Did + 主语 + 动词原形?
Did you live in the countryside as a child?
I / he / she / it was；you / we / they were

examples.en: I moved to Chengdu in 2018 to start a new job.
examples.cn: 我 2018 年搬到成都，开始一份新工作。
examples.note: in 2018 是明确的过去时间。

examples.en: When I was at primary school, we didn't have computers in the classroom.
examples.cn: 我上小学的时候，教室里没有电脑。
examples.note: didn't 后面的 have 用原形。

examples.en: How long did it take you to get used to life in the new city?
examples.cn: 你花了多长时间适应新城市的生活？

sections.heading: 规则变化与常用不规则动词
sections.body:
规则动词加 -ed：以 e 结尾只加 -d（live → lived）；辅音字母 + y 变 y 为 i 再加 -ed（study → studied）；重读闭音节末尾只有一个辅音字母时双写（stop → stopped，plan → planned）。英式拼写里 travel 的过去式是 travelled。

不规则动词没有规律，只能背。下表是口语讲经历最常用的一批，**过去式和过去分词不同的要分开记**，下一篇现在完成时会用到过去分词。

examples.en: We planned the trip carefully, but we still missed the last train.
examples.cn: 我们仔细规划了行程，但还是错过了末班车。
examples.note: plan → planned，双写 n。

examples.en: My grandfather taught me how to ride a bike when I was six.
examples.cn: 我六岁时，爷爷教我骑自行车。
examples.note: teach → taught。

examples.en: I spent three months in Manchester and travelled around the north of England.
examples.cn: 我在曼彻斯特待了三个月，还游览了英格兰北部。
examples.note: spend → spent；英式拼写 travelled。

sections.heading: 过去进行时：交代背景
sections.body: 过去进行时由 **was / were + 动词-ing** 构成，表示**过去某一时刻正在进行**的动作。讲故事时，它负责描绘背景（当时在干什么、天气怎样），一般过去时负责推进情节（接着发生了什么）。

head: 时态
作用
例子
rows: At 8 pm yesterday I was revising for my exam.
情节：一个个完成的动作
I finished my essay, saved it and went to bed.

examples.en: At this time last year, I was working as an intern at a design company.
examples.cn: 去年这个时候，我正在一家设计公司实习。

examples.en: It was raining heavily and everyone was hurrying home.
examples.cn: 当时雨下得很大，大家都在匆匆赶回家。
examples.note: 两个过去进行时一起描绘场景。

sections.heading: when 和 while：长动作被短动作打断
sections.body:
最常见的组合是**长动作被短动作打断**：持续的、正在进行的动作用过去进行时，突然发生的短动作用一般过去时。

**while** 后面通常接长动作（过去进行时）；**when** 后面通常接短动作（一般过去时）。两个长动作同时进行时，用 while 连接，两边都用过去进行时。

head: 句型
例子
rows: While + 过去进行时, 一般过去时
While I was waiting for the bus, I met an old classmate.
过去进行时 + when + 一般过去时
I was waiting for the bus when I met an old classmate.
While + 过去进行时, 过去进行时
While my mother was cooking, my father was cleaning the flat.

examples.en: I was walking to the library when it suddenly started to snow.
examples.cn: 我正走去图书馆，突然下起雪来。

examples.en: While we were discussing the project, the manager came in with some bad news.
examples.cn: 我们正在讨论项目时，经理带着坏消息进来了。

examples.en: What were you doing when you heard about your exam result?
examples.cn: 你得知考试成绩的时候正在做什么？

pitfalls.wrong: I buyed a new laptop last month.
pitfalls.right: I bought a new laptop last month.
pitfalls.why: buy 是不规则动词，过去式是 bought，不能按规则加 -ed。

pitfalls.wrong: Did you went to the concert?
pitfalls.right: Did you go to the concert?
pitfalls.why: 疑问句已经用了 did 表示过去，后面的动词回到原形。

pitfalls.wrong: Yesterday I go to the library and study for three hours.
pitfalls.right: Yesterday I went to the library and studied for three hours.
pitfalls.why: 中文靠「昨天」表示时间，动词不变；英语的动词本身要变成过去式，并列的每个动词都要变。

pitfalls.wrong: While I watched TV, the phone was ringing.
pitfalls.right: While I was watching TV, the phone rang.
pitfalls.why: 长短动作的时态搭反了：看电视是持续的背景，用过去进行时；电话响是突然发生的短动作，用一般过去时。

pitfalls.wrong: When I was walking home, I was seeing an accident.
pitfalls.right: When I was walking home, I saw an accident.
pitfalls.why: 看见事故是瞬间发生的事，用一般过去时；see 表示「看见」时一般不用进行时。

exercises.q: On my way to work, I ___ (stop) at a cafe to buy breakfast.
answer: stopped
exercises.explain: 已经结束的过去动作用一般过去时；stop 是重读闭音节，末尾双写 p 再加 -ed。

exercises.q: I ___ my keys while I was running for the bus.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙是突然发生的短动作，用一般过去时；跑着赶车是背景，用过去进行时。

exercises.q: What ___ you doing at ten o'clock last night?
exercises.explain: 问过去某一时刻正在做什么，用过去进行时；主语 you 配 were。

exercises.q: She ___ (not / go) to the meeting yesterday because she was ill.
answer: didn't go
did not go
exercises.explain: 一般过去时的否定用 didn't + 动词原形。

exercises.q: My parents buyed this flat ten years ago.
answer: My parents bought this flat ten years ago.
exercises.explain: buy 的过去式是不规则的 bought。

exercises.q: Did she wrote the report yesterday?
answer: Did she write the report yesterday?
exercises.explain: 已经用了 did，谓语动词回到原形 write。

title: 现在完成时
summary: 掌握 have / has + 过去分词，分清它和一般过去时，会用 for / since、already / yet / ever 谈经历、结果和变化。

sections.heading: 构成与三种核心用法
sections.body:
现在完成时由 **have / has + 过去分词** 构成。它连接过去和现在：动作发生在过去，但说话人关心的是**到现在为止的经历、对现在的影响，或者从过去持续到现在的状态**。

口语谈个人经历、Task 1 描述到目前为止的变化，都离不开它。

head: 用法
例子
rows: 经历：到现在为止做过没有
I have visited three European countries.
结果：过去的动作影响现在
I've lost my student card, so I can't borrow books.
持续：从过去持续到现在
She has lived in this city for ten years.
I haven't finished. / Have you ever tried Thai food?

examples.en: The city has built three new metro lines, so commuting is much easier now.
examples.cn: 这座城市新建了三条地铁线，现在通勤方便多了。
examples.note: 过去的动作带来了现在的结果。

examples.en: I've never been to a live football match.
examples.cn: 我从来没去现场看过足球比赛。

examples.en: Has your hometown changed much in recent years?
examples.cn: 你的家乡近些年变化大吗？
examples.note: 口语 Part 1 常见问法，回答时也用现在完成时。

sections.heading: 和一般过去时的区别
sections.body:
两者最大的区别在于**有没有明确的过去时间**。只要句子里出现 yesterday、last year、in 2015、two weeks ago、when I was young 这类明确的过去时间，就用一般过去时，不能用现在完成时。

可以这样记：一般过去时把事情放在过去某个点上，讲完就结束；现在完成时站在现在往回看，关心的是到现在为止的情况。口语里常见的做法是先用现在完成时引出经历，再用一般过去时补充细节。

head: 现在完成时
一般过去时
rows: I have been to London.（经历，不说何时）
I went to London last year.（明确时间）
He has lost his phone.（现在还没找到）
He lost his phone yesterday.（只陈述过去的事）
常用时间词：ever, never, already, yet, so far, recently, since
常用时间词：yesterday, ago, last ..., in + 过去年份, when ...

examples.en: I have been to Japan twice. The first time, I went there with my parents in 2016.
examples.cn: 我去过日本两次。第一次是 2016 年和父母一起去的。
examples.note: 先用现在完成时谈经历，再用一般过去时讲具体某一次。

examples.en: The number of cyclists in the city has doubled since 2015.
examples.cn: 自 2015 年以来，这座城市骑自行车的人数翻了一番。
examples.note: since 引出到现在为止的变化。

examples.en: I lost my wallet last week, but luckily someone found it.
examples.cn: 我上周丢了钱包，幸好有人捡到了。
examples.note: last week 是明确的过去时间。

sections.heading: for 和 since
sections.body:
表示从过去持续到现在，**for + 一段时间**，**since + 起点**（过去的时间点，或者一个一般过去时的从句）。提问用 How long。

注意：表示持续的句子要用 live、work、study、know、have 这类可以延续的动词。come、leave、buy、die 这类瞬间动词不能直接和 for 连用，要换成表示状态的说法，例如 He has been here for two hours.

examples.en: I have studied English for six years, but I have only taken the IELTS test once.
examples.cn: 我学英语六年了，但雅思只考过一次。

examples.en: She has worked as a nurse since she left university.
examples.cn: 她大学毕业后一直当护士。
examples.note: since 后面的从句用一般过去时。

examples.en: How long have you known your best friend?
examples.cn: 你认识你最好的朋友多久了？

sections.heading: already、yet、ever、never、just
sections.body: 这几个副词经常和现在完成时一起出现，位置有讲究：already、just、ever、never 一般放在 have / has 和过去分词之间；yet 放在句末，用于否定句和疑问句。

head: 词
意思
例子
rows: 还（否定句）/ 已经（疑问句）
I haven't received my score yet. / Have you received it yet?
I've never failed a driving test.

examples.en: We have already reduced our use of plastic bags at home.
examples.cn: 我们家已经减少了塑料袋的使用。

examples.en: The council hasn't decided where to build the new hospital yet.
examples.cn: 市政委员会还没决定新医院建在哪里。

examples.en: Have you ever thought about working in another country?
examples.cn: 你有没有想过去别的国家工作？

pitfalls.wrong: I have visited Shanghai last year.
pitfalls.right: I visited Shanghai last year.
pitfalls.why: 有明确的过去时间（last year）就不能用现在完成时。这是中国学习者最常见的完成时错误。

pitfalls.wrong: I have lived here since three years.
pitfalls.right: I have lived here for three years.
pitfalls.why: since 后接时间起点，一段时间要用 for。

pitfalls.wrong: He has came back from Canada.
pitfalls.right: He has come back from Canada.
pitfalls.why: have / has 后面接过去分词，不是过去式；come 的过去分词是 come。

pitfalls.wrong: My grandfather has died for two years.
pitfalls.right: My grandfather died two years ago.
pitfalls.why: die 是瞬间动词，不能和 for + 一段时间连用。可以用一般过去时加 ago，或者改成 has been dead for two years。

pitfalls.wrong: I have already finish the report.
pitfalls.right: I have already finished the report.
pitfalls.why: have 后面必须是过去分词，漏掉 -ed 是写快时的常见错误。

exercises.q: I ___ to Australia twice, and I'd love to go again.
exercises.explain: 谈到现在为止的经历用现在完成时。have been to 表示去过并已回来；have gone to 表示去了还没回来，说话人就在这里，不合逻辑。

exercises.q: The new library ___ in 2021.
exercises.explain: in 2021 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时。

exercises.q: She has worked for this charity ___ 2019.
answer: since
exercises.explain: 2019 是时间起点，用 since。

exercises.q: A: Have you read the article ___? B: No, not yet.
answer: yet
exercises.explain: 疑问句里问「已经……了吗」，用 yet，放在句末。

exercises.q: I have finished the essay two hours ago.
answer: I finished the essay two hours ago.
exercises.explain: two hours ago 是明确的过去时间，要用一般过去时。

exercises.q: She has went to the library.
answer: She has gone to the library.
She's gone to the library.
exercises.explain: has 后面接过去分词 gone，went 是过去式。

grammarTags: 现在完成时 vs 一般过去时

title: 将来的表达
summary: 分清 will、be going to 和现在进行时表将来，谈计划、预测和临时决定时用对形式。

sections.heading: will：预测、临时决定与承诺
sections.body:
**will + 动词原形** 是最基本的将来表达，主要有三种用法。

一是**凭个人看法预测**将来，常和 I think、probably、I'm sure 搭配，写作 Task 2 讨论未来趋势时很常用。二是**说话时临时做出的决定**。三是**承诺和主动提出帮忙**。否定是 won't，后面同样接动词原形。

head: 用法
例子
rows: I think robots will do many household jobs in the future.
The library is closed? Then I'll study at home.
I'll send you the notes tonight.
House prices probably won't fall next year.

examples.en: Electric cars will probably become cheaper over the next ten years.
examples.cn: 未来十年，电动汽车很可能会变便宜。
examples.note: probably 放在 will 之后。

examples.en: Don't worry, I'll help you carry those boxes.
examples.cn: 别担心，我来帮你搬那些箱子。
examples.note: 说话时临时决定帮忙。

examples.en: I don't think online classes will completely replace traditional schools.
examples.cn: 我认为网课不会完全取代传统学校。
examples.note: 英语习惯否定 think，而不是说 I think ... won't。

sections.heading: be going to：打算和有迹象的预测
sections.body:
**be going to + 动词原形** 有两个用法。

一是**说话之前就已经有的打算**。口语被问到 What are you going to do after the test? 用它回答最自然。

二是**根据眼前的迹象做出的预测**：看到乌云就说 It's going to rain.

head: will
be going to
rows: 说话时才决定：OK, I'll take the course.
早就打算好：I'm going to take the course in March.
凭看法预测：I think it will rain tomorrow.
凭迹象预测：Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.

examples.en: I'm going to apply for a master's degree in the UK next year.
examples.cn: 我打算明年申请英国的硕士。

examples.en: The traffic is terrible. We're going to be late for the lecture.
examples.cn: 路太堵了，我们上课要迟到了。
examples.note: 根据眼前的交通状况做预测。

examples.en: My cousin is going to start her own business after she graduates.
examples.cn: 我表姐打算毕业后自己创业。
examples.note: after 从句用一般现在时表示将来，见本篇最后一节。

sections.heading: 现在进行时与一般现在时表将来
sections.body:
现在进行时也可以表示将来，用于**已经安排好的个人计划**，比如约好的见面、订好的行程，通常带具体时间。

列车时刻表、考试日程这类**固定时间表**，则用一般现在时：The train leaves at 9.15.

head: 形式
适用场合
例子
rows: 已经约定或安排好的个人计划
I'm meeting my tutor on Friday afternoon.
The exam starts at 9 am tomorrow.
个人打算（不一定已经安排）
I'm going to look for a part-time job.

examples.en: We're flying to Edinburgh on Saturday; I've already booked the tickets.
examples.cn: 我们周六飞爱丁堡，票我已经订好了。

examples.en: What are you doing this weekend?
examples.cn: 你这周末有什么安排？
examples.note: 问对方已有的安排。

examples.en: The conference begins on 3 May and finishes two days later.
examples.cn: 会议 5 月 3 日开始，两天后结束。
examples.note: 固定日程用一般现在时。

sections.heading: 时间从句里不用 will
sections.body: 在 when、after、before、as soon as、until、if 引导的时间或条件从句里，即使说的是将来，也用**一般现在时**，只有主句用 will。这是写作里很常被扣分的将来时错误。

head: 错误
正确
rows: When I finish university, I'll look for a job abroad.
As soon as the results will come out, ...
As soon as the results come out, I'll let you know.

examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I arrive at the airport.
examples.cn: 我一到机场就给你打电话。

examples.en: If the city builds more cycle lanes, more people will cycle to work.
examples.cn: 如果城市修建更多自行车道，会有更多人骑车上班。
examples.note: if 从句同样用一般现在时，详见条件句一篇。

pitfalls.wrong: I will to visit my grandparents at the weekend.
pitfalls.right: I will visit my grandparents at the weekend.
pitfalls.why: will 后面直接接动词原形，不加 to。

pitfalls.wrong: I'm going travel next month.
pitfalls.right: I'm going to travel next month.
pitfalls.why: be going to 里的 to 不能省略。

pitfalls.wrong: When I will graduate, I will become a teacher.
pitfalls.right: When I graduate, I will become a teacher.
pitfalls.why: 时间从句用一般现在时表示将来，只有主句用 will。

pitfalls.wrong: Tomorrow I visit the museum with my class.
pitfalls.right: Tomorrow I'm visiting the museum with my class.
pitfalls.why: 中文「明天我去博物馆」没有将来标记，但英语要用将来表达；已安排好的个人计划用现在进行时或 be going to。

pitfalls.wrong: In the future, people will can work from anywhere.
pitfalls.right: In the future, people will be able to work from anywhere.
pitfalls.why: 两个情态动词不能连用，will 后面表示能力要用 be able to。

exercises.q: A: The printer isn't working. B: Don't worry, I ___ it for you.
exercises.explain: B 是说话时临时决定帮忙，用 will。

exercises.q: Look at the sky. It ___ snow.
exercises.explain: 根据眼前的迹象（天色）做预测，用 be going to。

exercises.q: I ___ (meet) my tutor at 3 pm tomorrow; we arranged it last week.
answer: am meeting
am going to meet
exercises.explain: 已经约好的个人安排，最自然的是现在进行时 am meeting；am going to meet 也可以接受。

exercises.q: I'll text you when the train ___ (arrive).
answer: arrives
exercises.explain: when 引导的时间从句用一般现在时表示将来，主语 the train 是单数，加 -s。

exercises.q: I will tell you as soon as I will get my results.
answer: I will tell you as soon as I get my results.
I'll tell you as soon as I get my results.
exercises.explain: as soon as 引导时间从句，从句用一般现在时，不用 will。

exercises.q: In the future, robots will can do most dangerous jobs.
answer: In the future, robots will be able to do most dangerous jobs.
In the future robots will be able to do most dangerous jobs.
exercises.explain: will 和 can 不能连用，表示将来的能力用 will be able to。

title: 冠词 a/an、the 与零冠词
titleEn: Articles: a/an, the and zero article
summary: 搞清泛指与特指，写作中正确处理 the environment、society、technology 这类高频词前的冠词。

sections.heading: a / an：单数可数名词，第一次提到
sections.body:
a / an 只用在**单数可数名词**前，表示「一个」或「某一个」，常用于第一次提到某物，或者说明某人的身份、职业。

选 a 还是 an 看的是**读音**，不是字母：以元音音素开头用 an，以辅音音素开头用 a。

head: 规则
例子
rows: a book, a university /juː/, a one-way street /w/, a European city
an idea, an hour /aʊ/, an MBA /em/, an honest answer
She is an engineer. / He works as a volunteer.

examples.en: My brother is a university student, and he wants to become an architect.
examples.cn: 我弟弟是大学生，他想当建筑师。
examples.note: university 以 /j/ 音开头，用 a。

examples.en: It took me an hour to get to the exam centre.
examples.cn: 我花了一个小时才到考点。
examples.note: hour 的 h 不发音，用 an。

examples.en: There is a park near my flat, and the park is always busy at weekends.
examples.cn: 我住的公寓附近有个公园，那个公园周末总是很热闹。
examples.note: 第一次提到用 a，再次提到用 the。

sections.heading: the：双方都知道指哪一个
sections.body:
the 表示**特指**，即说话双方都清楚指的是哪一个。常见情况有：前文提过的；后面有 of 短语或从句限定的（the history of China）；世界上独一无二的（the sun、the internet）；最高级和序数词前（the best、the first）。

判断方法：问自己「是哪一个？」如果听者答得出来，就用 the。

head: 情况
例子
rows: I bought a laptop. The laptop was quite cheap.
有 of 短语或从句限定
the cost of living / the students who passed the test
the sun, the internet, the government（本国政府）
the most important reason, the first step
play the piano, in the morning, go to the cinema

examples.en: The internet has changed the way people communicate.
examples.cn: 互联网改变了人们交流的方式。
examples.note: the way 被后面的 people communicate 限定。

examples.en: The quality of the air in my city has improved recently.
examples.cn: 我所在城市的空气质量最近有所改善。
examples.note: quality 被 of the air 限定，用 the。

examples.en: This is the most effective way to reduce traffic congestion.
examples.cn: 这是缓解交通拥堵最有效的办法。

sections.heading: 零冠词：泛指一类事物
sections.body:
泛指一类事物时，**复数名词和不可数名词前不加冠词**。这是雅思写作里最重要的一条，因为议论文大多在讨论泛指的话题。

比如 Children should learn to cook. 说的是所有孩子；The children in my class are noisy. 说的是特定的一群孩子。

此外，三餐、学科、球类运动、语言、大多数国名前也不加冠词；by bus、by car 等交通方式也不加。

head: 泛指（零冠词）
特指（加 the）
rows: The technology used in this factory is outdated.
The students at this school wear uniforms.
The pollution in this river comes from farms.
I study economics. / We play football.

examples.en: Education is the key to reducing poverty.
examples.cn: 教育是减少贫困的关键。
examples.note: education 泛指，不加冠词；key 被 to ... 限定，用 the。

examples.en: Many people believe that money cannot buy happiness.
examples.cn: 很多人认为金钱买不到幸福。
examples.note: money 和 happiness 都是泛指的不可数名词。

examples.en: Most of my classmates go to school by bike.
examples.cn: 我的大多数同学骑车上学。
examples.note: go to school、by bike 都不加冠词。

sections.heading: 雅思高频词：the environment、society、technology
sections.body:
有几个写作高频词的冠词用法比较固定，可以直接记下来。

**the environment** 指自然环境时几乎总带 the。**society**（社会整体）、**nature**（大自然）、**technology**、**science** 泛指时不加冠词。**the public**（公众）、**the government** 一般带 the。**the elderly / the young / the rich** 表示一类人，带 the，谓语用复数。

head: 写法
说明
例子
rows: 泛指自然环境也要加 the
Children should spend more time in nature.
the + 形容词表示一类人，谓语用复数
The government should listen to the public.

examples.en: Governments should do more to protect the environment.
examples.cn: 各国政府应该采取更多措施保护环境。
examples.note: governments 泛指各国政府，复数不加冠词；the environment 固定带 the。

examples.en: Modern technology has made it easier for the elderly to stay in touch with their families.
examples.cn: 现代科技让老年人更容易和家人保持联系。

examples.en: Science plays an important role in society.
examples.cn: 科学在社会中发挥着重要作用。

pitfalls.wrong: We must protect environment.
pitfalls.right: We must protect the environment.
pitfalls.why: environment 指自然环境时要加 the，这是写作里频率最高的冠词错误之一。

pitfalls.wrong: The technology has changed our lives.
pitfalls.right: Technology has changed our lives.
pitfalls.why: 泛指「科技」整体时不加 the。中文没有冠词，很多人见到名词就加 the。

pitfalls.wrong: In the modern society, people are busier than before.
pitfalls.right: In modern society, people are busier than before.
pitfalls.why: modern society 泛指现代社会，不加 the。这是作文开头的高频错误。

pitfalls.wrong: He is teacher.
pitfalls.right: He is a teacher.
pitfalls.why: 单数可数名词前不能什么都不加，说职业要用 a / an。

pitfalls.wrong: She is an university student.
pitfalls.right: She is a university student.
pitfalls.why: a / an 看读音而不是字母，university 以 /j/ 音开头，用 a。

exercises.q: Air pollution is damaging ___ environment in many cities.
exercises.explain: environment 指自然环境时固定带 the。

exercises.q: She hopes to become ___ engineer after graduation.
exercises.explain: 说职业用不定冠词；engineer 以元音音素开头，用 an。

exercises.q: In my opinion, ___ technology has made our lives more convenient.
exercises.explain: 这里泛指科技整体，technology 是不可数名词，泛指时不加冠词。

exercises.q: It takes me ___ hour to cycle to work.
answer: an
exercises.explain: hour 的 h 不发音，以元音音素 /aʊ/ 开头，用 an。

exercises.q: In the modern society, people rely heavily on smartphones.
answer: In modern society, people rely heavily on smartphones.
In modern society people rely heavily on smartphones.
exercises.explain: modern society 泛指现代社会，不加 the。

exercises.q: My father is engineer and he works for the government.
answer: My father is an engineer and he works for the government.
My father is an engineer, and he works for the government.
exercises.explain: 说职业时单数可数名词前要加不定冠词，engineer 以元音音素开头，用 an；the government 本身正确。

title: 可数与不可数名词及数量词
summary: 认清雅思高频不可数名词，正确搭配 much / many、few / little、the number of / the amount of，不再写出 informations、advices。

sections.heading: 可数与不可数：雅思高频不可数名词
sections.body:
可数名词有单复数，单数前要加 a / an 或其他限定词；不可数名词**没有复数形式，不能直接加 a / an**，作主语时谓语用单数。

有些词在中文里明明「可以数」，在英语里却是不可数的。雅思写作最常错的就是下面这一批，建议直接背下来。

head: 不可数名词
要表示「一条 / 一项」时
rows: a piece of advice / a suggestion
a piece of research / a study
a piece of homework / an assignment
a piece of news（虽以 s 结尾，仍是不可数，谓语用单数）
一般不说 a knowledge，也没有复数形式

examples.en: The website provides useful information about visa applications.
examples.cn: 这个网站提供了签证申请的有用信息。

examples.en: My tutor gave me a useful piece of advice: read English news every day.
examples.cn: 导师给了我一条有用的建议：每天读英文新闻。
examples.note: advice 不可数，表示一条用 a piece of。

examples.en: Recent research shows that regular exercise improves memory.
examples.cn: 最近的研究表明，规律运动能提升记忆力。
examples.note: research 不可数，不说 researches；谓语 shows 用单数。

sections.heading: 一个词两种用法
sections.body: 有些名词既可数又不可数，意思不同：作不可数名词时指物质或抽象概念，作可数名词时指具体的一个、一次或一种。

head: 不可数
可数
rows: a paper 一份报纸；一篇论文
a work of art 一件艺术作品

examples.en: Employers prefer candidates with work experience.
examples.cn: 雇主更青睐有工作经验的求职者。
examples.note: experience 表示经验，不可数。

examples.en: Studying abroad was an unforgettable experience for me.
examples.cn: 留学对我来说是一段难忘的经历。
examples.note: experience 表示一次经历，可数。

examples.en: There isn't enough room on the bus for all these bags.
examples.cn: 公交车上没有足够的空间放这么多包。
examples.note: room 表示空间，不可数。

sections.heading: 数量词搭配
sections.body:
数量词要和名词的可数性配套。可数名词用 many、a few、few、a number of；不可数名词用 much、a little、little、an amount of、a great deal of。some、any、a lot of、lots of、plenty of 两类都能用。

**few / little** 表示「很少，几乎没有」，语气偏否定；**a few / a little** 表示「有一些」，语气偏肯定。much 多用于否定句和疑问句，肯定句里更常用 a lot of。

examples.en: Few people in my village own a car, so the bus service is very important.
examples.cn: 我们村几乎没人有车，所以公交服务非常重要。
examples.note: few 表示几乎没有，强调少。

examples.en: We still have a little time, so let's check our answers.
examples.cn: 我们还有一点时间，检查一下答案吧。
examples.note: a little 表示还有一些。

examples.en: Cities with fewer cars usually have less air pollution.
examples.cn: 汽车更少的城市通常空气污染也更少。
examples.note: cars 可数用 fewer，pollution 不可数用 less。

sections.heading: Task 1 中的数量表达
sections.body:
描述图表时要根据名词的可数性选对说法。人、车、游客等可数名词用 **the number of**；水、电、能源、垃圾等不可数名词用 **the amount of**。

比例和百分比用 **the proportion / percentage of**，两类名词都可以。

examples.en: The number of international students rose steadily between 2010 and 2020.
examples.cn: 2010 年到 2020 年间，国际学生人数稳步上升。

examples.en: The amount of electricity generated from wind power doubled in five years.
examples.cn: 风力发电量在五年内翻了一番。

examples.en: Only a small proportion of the waste was recycled.
examples.cn: 只有一小部分垃圾被回收利用。

pitfalls.wrong: The teacher gave me many advices.
pitfalls.right: The teacher gave me a lot of advice.
pitfalls.why: advice 不可数，没有复数形式，也不能和 many 连用。

pitfalls.wrong: I need more informations about the course.
pitfalls.right: I need more information about the course.
pitfalls.why: information 不可数，不加 -s。

pitfalls.wrong: There are less cars in the city centre at weekends.
pitfalls.right: There are fewer cars in the city centre at weekends.
pitfalls.why: cars 可数，「更少」要用 fewer；less 搭配不可数名词。

pitfalls.wrong: The news are shocking.
pitfalls.right: The news is shocking.
pitfalls.why: news 以 s 结尾但不可数，谓语用单数。

pitfalls.wrong: The amount of tourists increased sharply.
pitfalls.right: The number of tourists increased sharply.
pitfalls.why: tourists 可数，Task 1 中要用 the number of。

exercises.q: How ___ homework do you usually get each week?
exercises.explain: homework 不可数，问数量用 how much。

exercises.q: Very ___ people in the survey said they never use the internet.
exercises.explain: people 是可数名词复数，「很少」用 few。

exercises.q: Scientists have carried out a lot of ___ (research) into renewable energy.
answer: research
exercises.explain: research 不可数，不加 -es。

exercises.q: The ___ of rubbish produced by households fell last year.
exercises.explain: rubbish 不可数，用 the amount of。

exercises.q: She gave me some useful advices about the interview.
answer: She gave me some useful advice about the interview.
exercises.explain: advice 不可数，没有复数形式。

exercises.q: There is less students in the library during the holidays.
answer: There are fewer students in the library during the holidays.
exercises.explain: students 是可数名词复数：be 动词用 are，「更少」用 fewer。

title: 主谓一致
summary: 找准真正的主语，处理好 the number of、people、every、集体名词等常见陷阱，写作长句里谓语单复数不出错。

sections.heading: 先找到真正的主语
sections.body:
主谓一致的基本规则很简单：单数主语配单数谓语，复数主语配复数谓语。难点在于**主语和谓语离得远**时，很容易把中间的名词误当成主语。

写长句时，先划掉主语后面的介词短语（of ...、in ...、with ...）和从句，再看剩下的核心名词是单数还是复数。

head: 句子
真正的主语
谓语
rows: The quality of these products is poor.
The students in my class are friendly.
One of the main reasons is cost.
The rise in house prices has caused problems.

examples.en: The main cause of these problems is a lack of funding.
examples.cn: 这些问题的主要原因是资金不足。
examples.note: 主语是 cause，不是 problems。

examples.en: One of my favourite places in the city is the old harbour.
examples.cn: 这座城市里我最喜欢的地方之一是老港口。
examples.note: one of + 复数名词，谓语跟着 one 用单数。

examples.en: The benefits of learning a foreign language are obvious.
examples.cn: 学外语的好处显而易见。
examples.note: 主语是 benefits，复数。

sections.heading: the number of 与 a number of
sections.body:
这一对是写作 Task 1 的高频考点。

**the number of + 复数名词**：意思是「……的数量」，核心词是 number，谓语用**单数**。

**a number of + 复数名词**：意思是「许多……」，相当于 many，核心词是后面的复数名词，谓语用**复数**。

同理，the amount of + 不可数名词 用单数；a lot of、most of、some of、half of、百分比 + of 后面的谓语，要看 of 后面的名词是复数还是不可数。

head: 结构
意思
谓语
例子
rows: the number of + 复数名词
The number of cyclists has increased.
a number of + 复数名词
A number of cyclists have complained.
Most of the students live on campus.
Most of the money goes on rent.
看 of 后面的名词
20% of the land is forest. / 20% of the workers were women.

examples.en: The number of people using public transport fell slightly in 2020.
examples.cn: 2020 年乘坐公共交通的人数略有下降。

examples.en: A number of experts have warned about the risks of artificial intelligence.
examples.cn: 不少专家已经就人工智能的风险发出警告。

examples.en: About 60% of the country's energy comes from coal.
examples.cn: 这个国家约 60% 的能源来自煤炭。
examples.note: energy 不可数，谓语用单数 comes。

sections.heading: people、police 与 every、each
sections.body:
有些名词没有 -s 却总是复数，谓语必须用复数，比如 **people**、**police**。反过来，news、economics、physics、mathematics 虽然以 s 结尾，却按单数处理。

**every / each + 单数名词**，以及 **everyone、everybody、nobody、something** 作主语时，都按单数处理，哪怕意思是「所有人」。

head: 总是复数
按单数处理
rows: news is, economics is, physics is
every student has, each country has

examples.en: Young people are more likely to rent than to buy a home.
examples.cn: 年轻人更倾向于租房而不是买房。

examples.en: The police are investigating the cause of the fire.
examples.cn: 警方正在调查火灾原因。

examples.en: Every student has to complete a project in the final year.
examples.cn: 每个学生最后一年都要完成一个项目。
examples.note: every + 单数名词 + 单数谓语。

examples.en: Economics is one of the most popular subjects at my university.
examples.cn: 经济学是我们大学最热门的专业之一。

sections.heading: 集体名词：family、government、team
sections.body:
family、team、government、staff、audience 这类集体名词，在**英式英语**里既可以按单数也可以按复数：看作一个整体时用单数，强调其中的成员时用复数。雅思写作两种都接受，**关键是同一篇里保持一致**，代词也要跟着走（it / its 或 they / their）。

拿不准时，把 government、company 当单数处理最稳妥：The government has announced its plan.

head: 看作整体（单数）
强调成员（复数）
rows: My family are all keen cyclists.
The team has won the cup.
The team are training hard for the final.
The government has introduced a new tax.
The staff are unhappy about the changes.

examples.en: The government has promised to build more affordable housing.
examples.cn: 政府已承诺建造更多经济适用房。

examples.en: The company has changed its policy on remote working.
examples.cn: 公司改变了远程办公政策。
examples.note: 单数谓语 has 配单数代词 its，前后一致。

pitfalls.wrong: The number of students have increased.
pitfalls.right: The number of students has increased.
pitfalls.why: the number of 的核心词是 number，谓语用单数。这是 Task 1 极高频的错误。

pitfalls.wrong: People is worried about rising rents.
pitfalls.right: People are worried about rising rents.
pitfalls.why: people 本身就是复数，谓语用复数。

pitfalls.wrong: Everyone have a smartphone nowadays.
pitfalls.right: Everyone has a smartphone nowadays.
pitfalls.why: everyone 虽然指所有人，语法上按单数处理。

pitfalls.wrong: The price of houses in big cities are very high.
pitfalls.right: The price of houses in big cities is very high.
pitfalls.why: 主语是 price，后面的 houses 和 cities 只是修饰成分。

pitfalls.wrong: One of the biggest problem is traffic.
pitfalls.right: One of the biggest problems is traffic.
pitfalls.why: one of 后面接复数名词，谓语跟着 one 用单数。两处都容易错。

exercises.q: The number of overseas visitors ___ risen sharply since 2015.
exercises.explain: the number of 的核心词是 number，单数，用 has。

exercises.q: A number of residents ___ complained about the noise from the new airport.
exercises.explain: a number of 相当于 many，核心词是 residents，复数，用 have。

exercises.q: Every child ___ (have) the right to a free education.
answer: has
exercises.explain: every + 单数名词作主语，谓语用单数。

exercises.q: The police ___ (be) looking for witnesses to the accident.
answer: are
exercises.explain: police 总是按复数处理。

exercises.q: The quality of the roads in rural areas are getting worse.
answer: The quality of the roads in rural areas is getting worse.
exercises.explain: 主语是 quality，单数；roads 和 areas 只是修饰成分。

exercises.q: Many people thinks that technology makes us lazy.
answer: Many people think that technology makes us lazy.
Many people think technology makes us lazy.
exercises.explain: people 是复数，谓语 think 不加 -s；从句主语 technology 不可数，makes 正确。

title: 比较级与最高级
summary: 掌握比较级、最高级和 as ... as 的构成，会用 twice as ... as、the + 比较级, the + 比较级 描述图表数据和观点。

sections.heading: 构成规则
sections.body:
单音节和部分双音节形容词加 -er / -est；多数双音节和三个音节以上的形容词前加 more / most。最高级前一般加 the，后面常跟 in + 范围 或 of + 群体。

比较级前可以加 much、far、a lot 表示「……得多」。

head: 类型
比较级
最高级
rows: the most expensive, the most popular
the best / the worst / the furthest

examples.en: Living in the city centre is more convenient but much more expensive.
examples.cn: 住在市中心更方便，但也贵得多。
examples.note: much 修饰比较级。

examples.en: Tokyo is one of the largest cities in the world.
examples.cn: 东京是世界上最大的城市之一。
examples.note: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

examples.en: Traffic in my city is getting worse every year.
examples.cn: 我们城市的交通一年比一年糟。
examples.note: bad 的比较级是不规则的 worse。

sections.heading: as ... as 与倍数表达
sections.body:
**as + 原级 + as** 表示「和……一样」，否定 not as ... as 表示「不如……」。

倍数表达是 Task 1 描述数据的利器，常见两种结构：**倍数 + as + 原级 + as**，或者 **倍数 + 比较级 + than**（多用于三倍及以上）。两倍用 twice，一半用 half。

head: 结构
例子
rows: At rush hour the bus is as fast as the train.
Online courses are not as interactive as classroom teaching.
twice / three times + as + 原级 + as
Rent in London is twice as high as in Manchester.
This car uses three times more fuel than that one.
Train tickets cost half as much as plane tickets.
倍数 + the + 名词 + of
In 2020 the city used three times the amount of water it used in 1990.

examples.en: In 2010, women spent twice as much time on housework as men did.
examples.cn: 2010 年，女性花在家务上的时间是男性的两倍。
examples.note: time 不可数，用 as much ... as。

examples.en: The number of cars in 2020 was three times as high as in 1990.
examples.cn: 2020 年的汽车数量是 1990 年的三倍。

examples.en: Solar power is not as expensive as it used to be.
examples.cn: 太阳能发电没有过去那么贵了。

sections.heading: the + 比较级, the + 比较级
sections.body:
这个结构表示「越……就越……」，两个分句**都以 the + 比较级开头**，后面接主语和谓语。口语和写作 Task 2 讨论因果关系时很好用。

比较的如果是名词，要写成 the more + 名词（the more money）；前半句说将来时也用一般现在时，后半句用 will。

head: 结构
例子
rows: the + 比较级 + 主谓, the + 比较级 + 主谓
The earlier you start, the better you will do.
the more + 名词 + 主谓, ...
The more cars there are, the more polluted the air becomes.

examples.en: The more you practise speaking, the more confident you will become.
examples.cn: 口语练得越多，你就会越自信。
examples.note: 英式拼写：动词 practise，名词 practice。

examples.en: The bigger a city becomes, the harder it is to find affordable housing.
examples.cn: 城市越大，越难找到负担得起的住房。

examples.en: The more time children spend on screens, the less time they spend outdoors.
examples.cn: 孩子看屏幕的时间越多，在户外的时间就越少。

sections.heading: 修饰比较级
sections.body: 想说「……得多」或「稍微……」时，在比较级前加修饰语。**very 不能修饰比较级**。这类修饰语能让 Task 1 的数据描述更精确。

head: 程度
修饰语
例子
rows: The figure was slightly lower than expected.
This is by far the most popular option.

examples.en: Train travel is far more environmentally friendly than flying.
examples.cn: 坐火车比坐飞机环保得多。

examples.en: Unemployment was slightly higher in the north than in the south.
examples.cn: 北部的失业率略高于南部。

pitfalls.wrong: This city is more bigger than my hometown.
pitfalls.right: This city is much bigger than my hometown.
pitfalls.why: big 已经变成 bigger，不能再加 more；想强调差距用 much。

pitfalls.wrong: Housing is very more expensive now.
pitfalls.right: Housing is much more expensive now.
pitfalls.why: very 不能修饰比较级，要用 much、far、a lot。

pitfalls.wrong: The price is two times as high than last year.
pitfalls.right: The price is twice as high as it was last year.
pitfalls.why: 两倍习惯用 twice；as ... as 不能和 than 混用。

pitfalls.wrong: The more you read, you will know more.
pitfalls.right: The more you read, the more you will know.
pitfalls.why: 「越……越……」结构的后半句也要以 the + 比较级开头。

pitfalls.wrong: He is the most tallest student in our class.
pitfalls.right: He is the tallest student in our class.
pitfalls.why: tallest 已经是最高级，不能再加 most。

exercises.q: Public transport in my city is ___ than it was ten years ago.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是 better，不能再加 more；very 不修饰比较级，用 much。

exercises.q: Shanghai is one of ___ (busy) ports in the world.
answer: the busiest
exercises.explain: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词；busy 是辅音字母 + y，变 y 为 i 加 -est。

exercises.q: In 2020, the factory produced twice ___ cars as in 2010.
exercises.explain: cars 是可数名词，用 as many ... as；twice 后面接 as ... as。

exercises.q: The harder you work, ___ (good) your results will be.
answer: the better
exercises.explain: 「越……越……」结构，后半句也以 the + 比较级开头，good 的比较级是 better。

exercises.q: Living in the countryside is more cheaper than living in the city.
answer: Living in the countryside is cheaper than living in the city.
Living in the countryside is much cheaper than living in the city.
exercises.explain: cheap 是单音节词，比较级 cheaper，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: Online shopping is not as convenient than people think.
answer: Online shopping is not as convenient as people think.
Online shopping is not so convenient as people think.
exercises.explain: not as ... as 是固定搭配，第二个 as 不能换成 than。

title: 情态动词
summary: 用 can / could / may / might / must / should 表达能力、可能、推测和建议，让写作观点有分寸、口语回答更自然。

sections.heading: 基本规则
sections.body:
情态动词表示说话人的态度（能力、可能、义务、建议），**后面一律接动词原形**；第三人称单数不加 -s；否定直接在后面加 not；疑问句把情态动词提到主语前。

两个情态动词不能连用，需要时用 be able to、have to 来替换：will be able to、might have to。

head: 规则
正确
错误
rows: She can speaks / can to speak French.

examples.en: Students should not use their phones during lectures.
examples.cn: 学生上课时不应该使用手机。

examples.en: I might have to work this weekend.
examples.cn: 我这周末可能得加班。
examples.note: might 和 have to 连用，表示「可能不得不」。

examples.en: Can you speak any other languages?
examples.cn: 你还会说其他语言吗？
examples.note: 口语 Part 1 常见问法。

sections.heading: 能力与许可：can、could、be able to
sections.body:
**can** 表示现在的能力或许可，**could** 表示过去的一般能力，也可以用于更礼貌的请求。

说过去**某一次成功做成**了某事，不用 could，而用 was / were able to 或 managed to。否定时 couldn't 不受这个限制。

head: 意思
现在
过去
rows: I could swim when I was five.
We were able to / managed to find a cheap hotel.
Can I sit here? / Could you help me?

examples.en: My grandmother can't use a smartphone, but she can make video calls on a tablet.
examples.cn: 我奶奶不会用智能手机，但会用平板电脑打视频电话。

examples.en: When I was a child, I could walk to school safely.
examples.cn: 我小时候可以安全地走路上学。
examples.note: could 表示过去一般的能力或可能。

examples.en: The roads were icy, but we were able to get home before dark.
examples.cn: 路面结冰了，但我们还是在天黑前到了家。
examples.note: 某一次成功做到，用 were able to。

sections.heading: 推测：must、may、might、could、can't
sections.body:
情态动词可以表示说话人**有多大把握**。由强到弱大致是：must（一定是）→ may / might / could（可能是）→ can't（不可能是）。

注意：肯定推测 must 的反义是 **can't**，不是 mustn't；mustn't 表示禁止。写作 Task 2 谈影响时，用 may、might、could 能让论点更有分寸，避免说得太绝对。

head: 把握
情态动词
例子
rows: The lights are on, so they must be at home.
This policy may reduce traffic in the city centre.
He can't be the manager; he looks about eighteen.

examples.en: You've been working all day; you must be exhausted.
examples.cn: 你忙了一整天，一定累坏了。

examples.en: Working from home could help parents spend more time with their children.
examples.cn: 居家办公可能有助于父母多陪孩子。
examples.note: could 表示可能性，语气客观、留有余地。

examples.en: That can't be the right answer; the total is more than 100%.
examples.cn: 那不可能是正确答案，总数超过了 100%。

sections.heading: 义务与建议：must、have to、should
sections.body:
**must** 多表示说话人自己认为必须做的事，**have to** 多表示外部规定或客观需要。否定时差别很大：**mustn't** 是「不允许」，**don't have to** 是「不必」。

**should** 表示建议或「应该」，是写作 Task 2 提出解决办法时最常用的情态动词，比 must 委婉。

head: 形式
意思
例子
rows: I must finish this essay tonight.
All students have to wear a uniform.
You mustn't use a dictionary in the exam.
You don't have to bring your own laptop.
The government should invest more in public transport.

examples.en: Schools should teach children how to manage money.
examples.cn: 学校应该教孩子如何理财。

examples.en: In the UK, learner drivers have to pass a theory test before they can take the practical test.
examples.cn: 在英国，学车的人必须先通过理论考试，才能参加路考。
examples.note: 外部规定用 have to。

examples.en: You don't have to pay to visit many museums in London.
examples.cn: 伦敦很多博物馆参观是免费的，不必付钱。

pitfalls.wrong: She can speaks three languages.
pitfalls.right: She can speak three languages.
pitfalls.why: 情态动词后面接动词原形，不加 -s。

pitfalls.wrong: You must to wear a helmet.
pitfalls.right: You must wear a helmet.
pitfalls.why: 情态动词后面不加 to（have to、ought to 是例外）。

pitfalls.wrong: People will can travel to Mars in the future.
pitfalls.right: People will be able to travel to Mars in the future.
pitfalls.why: 两个情态动词不能连用，will 后面用 be able to 表示能力。

pitfalls.wrong: He mustn't be at home; his car isn't there.
pitfalls.right: He can't be at home; his car isn't there.
pitfalls.why: 否定推测「不可能」用 can't；mustn't 表示禁止。

pitfalls.wrong: You mustn't come tomorrow if you are busy.
pitfalls.right: You don't have to come tomorrow if you are busy.
pitfalls.why: 这里想说「不必来」，要用 don't have to 或 needn't；mustn't 是「不许来」，意思完全不同。

exercises.q: She has been studying for twelve hours. She ___ be very tired.
exercises.explain: 根据学了十二小时这个事实，有把握地推测「一定很累」，用 must。

exercises.q: You ___ bring food into the library; it's against the rules.
exercises.explain: 违反规定，表示禁止，用 mustn't；don't have to 和 needn't 都是「不必」。

exercises.q: The fire spread quickly, but everyone ___ escape from the building.
exercises.explain: 过去某一次成功做到，用 was able to，不用 could。

exercises.q: The test is free, so you ___ (not / have) to pay anything.
answer: don't have
do not have
exercises.explain: 表示「不必」用 don't have to。

exercises.q: I think the government should to ban plastic bags.
answer: I think the government should ban plastic bags.
exercises.explain: should 后面直接接动词原形，不加 to。

exercises.q: That mustn't be Tom; he is on holiday in Spain.
answer: That can't be Tom; he is on holiday in Spain.
That can't be Tom, he is on holiday in Spain.
That cannot be Tom; he is on holiday in Spain.
That can't be Tom; he's on holiday in Spain.
exercises.explain: 否定推测「不可能是」用 can't；mustn't 表示禁止。

title: 被动语态基础
summary: 掌握一般现在时、一般过去时、现在完成时的被动，能用被动语态清楚描述 Task 1 流程图，读懂学术文章里的被动句。

sections.heading: 什么时候用被动
sections.body:
被动语态的结构是 **be + 过去分词**。当**动作的承受者比执行者更重要**，或者执行者不知道、不必说时，就用被动。需要说出执行者时，用 by 引出。

学术文章和 Task 1 流程图大量使用被动，因为重点是「东西被怎么处理」，而不是「谁处理」。

head: 主动
被动
rows: Workers collect the rubbish every Monday.
The rubbish is collected every Monday.
Someone stole my bike last night.
My bike was stolen last night.
Scientists have discovered a new species.
A new species has been discovered.

examples.en: English is spoken in many countries around the world.
examples.cn: 世界上很多国家都说英语。
examples.note: 执行者是谁不重要，用被动。

examples.en: The bridge was designed by a famous Italian architect.
examples.cn: 这座桥是一位著名的意大利建筑师设计的。
examples.note: by 引出执行者。

examples.en: Many trees have been cut down to make room for new roads.
examples.cn: 为了修新路，很多树被砍掉了。

sections.heading: 三种常用时态的被动
sections.body: 被动语态的时态靠 be 的变化来体现，过去分词始终不变。A2 到 B1 阶段先掌握下面三种。

head: 时态
被动结构
例子
rows: am / is / are + 过去分词
have / has been + 过去分词
The results have been published online.
The road wasn't repaired last year.
Is the exam marked by computer?

examples.en: These phones are assembled in one country and sold all over the world.
examples.cn: 这些手机在一个国家组装，然后销往世界各地。
examples.note: 并列的两个被动可以省略第二个 are。

examples.en: The old factory was turned into an art gallery in 2015.
examples.cn: 这座旧工厂在 2015 年被改造成了美术馆。

examples.en: Smoking has been banned in all restaurants in the city.
examples.cn: 这座城市所有餐馆都已禁止吸烟。

sections.heading: Task 1 流程图：描述工序
sections.body:
流程图描述的是一个产品或材料**经过哪些步骤**，主语通常是原料或产品，所以几乎每一步都用**一般现在时的被动**。

再配合 first、next、then、after that、finally 等顺序词，以及 once、after 等连接词，就能写出清楚的步骤链。

head: 顺序词
例子
rows: First, the tea leaves are picked by hand.
Next, they are dried in the sun for several hours.
Once the leaves have been dried, they are crushed.
Finally, the tea is packed and sent to shops.

examples.en: At the first stage, glass bottles are collected and taken to a recycling plant.
examples.cn: 第一步，玻璃瓶被收集起来，运到回收厂。

examples.en: The bottles are then washed, sorted by colour and crushed into small pieces.
examples.cn: 接着，瓶子被清洗、按颜色分类，并压碎成小块。
examples.note: then 放在 be 和过去分词之间；英式拼写 colour。

examples.en: Finally, the melted glass is shaped into new bottles.
examples.cn: 最后，熔化的玻璃被制成新瓶子。

sections.heading: 被动语态的易错点
sections.body:
**不及物动词没有被动**：happen、occur、rise、fall、increase、arrive、appear、disappear 不能用于被动。Task 1 描述数据升降时，应该说 The figure rose，不能说 was risen。

**不能漏掉 be**：The new hospital built last year. 缺少谓语，正确的是 The new hospital was built last year.

**不要滥用被动**：Task 2 表达自己的观点时，主动语态更直接，I believe ... 比 It is believed by me ... 自然得多。

head: 错误
正确
rows: The accident was happened at night.
Sales were increased by 20% last year.
The new hospital built last year.
The new hospital was built last year.

examples.en: The number of visitors increased sharply after the museum was renovated.
examples.cn: 博物馆翻修后，参观人数大幅增加。
examples.note: increased 是主动（不及物），was renovated 是被动。

examples.en: Several changes have been made to the timetable.
examples.cn: 时间表已经做了几处调整。

pitfalls.wrong: The car was stole last night.
pitfalls.right: The car was stolen last night.
pitfalls.why: 被动要用过去分词，不是过去式；不规则动词尤其要注意 steal - stole - stolen。

pitfalls.wrong: The meeting was happened yesterday.
pitfalls.right: The meeting happened yesterday.
pitfalls.why: happen 是不及物动词，没有被动形式。

pitfalls.wrong: This bridge built in 1990.
pitfalls.right: This bridge was built in 1990.
pitfalls.why: 漏了 be，句子没有谓语。中文「这座桥建于 1990 年」没有「被」字，很容易漏掉。

pitfalls.wrong: Then the fruit is wash and cut into pieces.
pitfalls.right: Then the fruit is washed and cut into pieces.
pitfalls.why: be 后面要接过去分词，wash 要加 -ed。流程图里这类漏写很常见。

pitfalls.wrong: Many new houses have built in my town.
pitfalls.right: Many new houses have been built in my town.
pitfalls.why: 现在完成时的被动是 have / has been + 过去分词，been 不能漏。

exercises.q: In the next stage, the raw cotton ___ to remove dirt.
exercises.explain: 棉花是被清洗的对象，流程图用一般现在时的被动 is + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The Eiffel Tower ___ (build) for the 1889 World's Fair.
answer: was built
exercises.explain: 塔是被建造的，过去的事用一般过去时的被动 was + 过去分词。

exercises.q: Since 2010, thousands of trees ___ (plant) along the river.
answer: have been planted
exercises.explain: since 2010 表示到现在为止，用现在完成时；树是被种的，用 have been + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The population of the city ___ from 2 million to 3 million.
exercises.explain: rise 是不及物动词，没有被动，直接用过去式 rose。

exercises.q: The museum built in the 19th century.
answer: The museum was built in the 19th century.
The museum was built in the nineteenth century.
exercises.explain: 博物馆是被建造的，要用被动 was built，不能漏掉 be。

exercises.q: The bottles are collect and taken to a factory.
answer: The bottles are collected and taken to a factory.
exercises.explain: 被动语态中 be 后面接过去分词 collected。

title: 条件句 0/1/2 型
summary: 掌握三类条件句的时态搭配，能谈普遍规律、可能的结果和假设情况，写作提建议、口语回答假设问题时不再混用时态。

sections.heading: 三类条件句总览
sections.body:
条件句由 **if 从句**（条件）和**主句**（结果）组成。三类条件句的区别在于「这件事有多真实」：0 型是普遍规律，1 型是将来真实可能发生的事，2 型是与现在事实相反或不太可能发生的假设。

if 从句可以放在前面，也可以放在后面；放在前面时，两个分句之间加逗号。

head: 类型
if 从句
主句
用途
rows: will / can / may + 动词原形
将来真实可能发生的情况
一般过去时（be 常用 were）
would / could / might + 动词原形
与现在相反或不太可能的假设

examples.en: If you heat ice, it melts.
examples.cn: 冰受热就会融化。
examples.note: 0 型：普遍规律。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, the match will be cancelled.
examples.cn: 如果明天下雨，比赛就会取消。
examples.note: 1 型：将来可能发生。

examples.en: If I had more free time, I would learn to play the piano.
examples.cn: 如果我有更多空闲时间，我会学弹钢琴。
examples.note: 2 型：与现在事实相反。

sections.heading: 0 型与 1 型：规律和真实可能
sections.body:
**0 型**说的是「只要……就总会……」，if 可以换成 when，意思基本不变。

**1 型**说的是将来有可能发生的情况及其结果。最关键的一点：**if 从句用一般现在时表示将来**，不能用 will，这和「将来的表达」一篇讲的时间从句规则一样。1 型的主句也可以用 can、may、might、should 或祈使句。

**unless** 相当于 if ... not。

head: 句型
例子
rows: If people don't get enough sleep, they find it hard to concentrate.
If the government raises fuel taxes, fewer people will drive.
If you live near your workplace, you may save a lot of time.
If you feel nervous in the speaking test, take a deep breath.
You won't improve unless you practise every day.

examples.en: If plants don't get enough light, they grow slowly.
examples.cn: 植物光照不足就会长得慢。

examples.en: If more people use public transport, traffic congestion will decrease.
examples.cn: 如果更多人乘坐公共交通，交通拥堵就会减轻。
examples.note: Task 2 讨论措施效果的常用句。

examples.en: Unless we reduce waste, our landfill sites will soon be full.
examples.cn: 除非我们减少垃圾，否则垃圾填埋场很快就会满。

sections.heading: 2 型：与现在相反的假设
sections.body:
2 型条件句用**过去时的形式**表达**现在或将来的假设**，并不是在说过去。它表示说话人认为这件事不真实或不太可能。

be 动词在 if 从句中常用 **were**，不论主语是什么人称；If I were you ... 是给建议的固定说法。日常口语里 I / he / she / it was 也很常见。主句用 would / could / might + 动词原形。

口语 Part 3 遇到 If you could change one thing about your city, what would it be? 这类问题，就要用 2 型回答。

head: 句型
例子
rows: If + 过去式, would + 动词原形
If I lived closer to the sea, I would go swimming every day.
If + were, would + 动词原形
If I were the mayor, I would build more parks.
If + 过去式, could / might + 动词原形
If cities had better cycle lanes, more people might cycle to work.
If I were you, I would book the test early.

examples.en: If I could change one thing about my city, I would make public transport free.
examples.cn: 如果我能改变我们城市的一件事，我会让公共交通免费。

examples.en: If everyone recycled their waste, we wouldn't need so many landfill sites.
examples.cn: 如果每个人都回收垃圾，我们就不需要那么多填埋场了。

examples.en: What would you do if you won a lot of money?
examples.cn: 如果你中了一大笔钱，你会做什么？

sections.heading: 1 型还是 2 型
sections.body: 同一个话题既可以用 1 型也可以用 2 型，取决于说话人觉得**这件事有多大可能**。觉得很可能发生，用 1 型；觉得不太可能或纯属假设，用 2 型。

head: 1 型（可能发生）
2 型（不太可能 / 假设）
rows: If I pass the test, I will study in Australia.
If I got a 9 in the test, I would be amazed.
If the council builds a new library, students will use it.
If every town had a free library, more children would read.

examples.en: If I get a 7 in IELTS, I will apply to a university in the UK.
examples.cn: 如果雅思考到 7 分，我就申请英国的大学。
examples.note: 真实的目标，用 1 型。

examples.en: If I didn't have to work, I would travel around the world.
examples.cn: 如果我不用工作，我就去环游世界。
examples.note: 不现实的假设，用 2 型。

pitfalls.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
pitfalls.right: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
pitfalls.why: 1 型条件句的 if 从句用一般现在时表示将来，不用 will。

pitfalls.wrong: If I have a lot of money, I would buy a house.
pitfalls.right: If I had a lot of money, I would buy a house.
pitfalls.why: 2 型的 if 从句用过去式，主句用 would，前后时态要配套。

pitfalls.wrong: If I were you, I will take a break.
pitfalls.right: If I were you, I would take a break.
pitfalls.why: If I were you 是 2 型假设，主句要用 would。

pitfalls.wrong: If people would use public transport, the air would be cleaner.
pitfalls.right: If people used public transport, the air would be cleaner.
pitfalls.why: if 从句里一般不用 would，would 只放在主句。

pitfalls.wrong: Unless you don't study, you will fail.
pitfalls.right: Unless you study, you will fail.
pitfalls.why: unless 本身就是 if ... not，不能再加否定。

exercises.q: If you mix red and blue, you ___ purple.
exercises.explain: 颜色混合是普遍规律，用 0 型，两边都用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If the city ___ (build) a new bridge, journey times will be shorter.
answer: builds
exercises.explain: 1 型条件句，if 从句用一般现在时表示将来；the city 是单数，加 -s。

exercises.q: If I ___ the prime minister, I would invest more in education.
exercises.explain: 与现实相反的假设，用 2 型，if 从句中 be 用 were。

exercises.q: If more people worked from home, there ___ (be) less traffic in the morning.
answer: would be
might be
could be
exercises.explain: if 从句用过去式 worked，是 2 型假设，主句用 would + 动词原形；might / could be 表示可能，也正确。

exercises.q: If I will have time this weekend, I will visit the museum.
answer: If I have time this weekend, I will visit the museum.
If I have time this weekend, I'll visit the museum.
exercises.explain: 1 型条件句的 if 从句用一般现在时，不用 will。

exercises.q: If I had a car, I will drive to work.
answer: If I had a car, I would drive to work.
If I had a car, I'd drive to work.
exercises.explain: if 从句是过去式 had，属于 2 型假设，主句要用 would。

title: 动名词与不定式
summary: 记住常见动词后接 doing 还是 to do，分清 stop、remember、forget、try 两种用法的意思差别，不再说出 enjoy to do 这类错误。

sections.heading: 后接动名词的动词
sections.body:
有一批动词后面只能接**动词-ing（动名词）**，不能接 to do，多表示喜好、完成、避免、建议等。

另外，**介词后面一律接动名词**，包括 be interested in、be good at、look forward to、instead of、without 等。其中 look forward to 的 to 是介词，后面接 doing。

head: 类别
动词 / 短语
例子
rows: enjoy, mind, don't mind, can't stand
finish, keep, give up, carry on
Try to avoid using your phone before bed.
interested in, good at, look forward to, without
I'm looking forward to hearing from you.

examples.en: I don't mind sharing a flat, as long as it's clean.
examples.cn: 只要干净，我不介意合租。

examples.en: Many people have given up eating meat for environmental reasons.
examples.cn: 很多人出于环保原因不再吃肉。

examples.en: Instead of driving, more people are choosing to cycle to work.
examples.cn: 越来越多的人不再开车，而是选择骑车上班。
examples.note: instead of 是介词短语，后接 driving。

sections.heading: 后接不定式的动词
sections.body:
另一批动词后面接 **to + 动词原形**，多表示意愿、计划、决定、设法等**指向将来**的动作。

「形容词 + to do」也很常见：It is important to ...、It's difficult to ...。写作 Task 2 里 It is essential for governments to ... 是很实用的句型。

head: 类别
动词
例子
rows: want, hope, plan, expect, would like
They decided to move to the countryside.
I can't afford to buy a car.
It is difficult to find a job in this field.

examples.en: After graduating, I decided to work for a year before doing a master's degree.
examples.cn: 毕业后，我决定先工作一年再读硕士。
examples.note: decide 后接 to do；after、before 是介词，后接 doing。

examples.en: Many young people cannot afford to buy a home in big cities.
examples.cn: 很多年轻人在大城市买不起房。

examples.en: It is important for children to learn how to cook.
examples.cn: 让孩子学会做饭很重要。

sections.heading: 两种都能接但意思不同：stop、remember、forget、try
sections.body:
like、love、prefer、start、begin、continue 后面接 doing 或 to do，意思差别不大。

但下面四个动词两种形式意思明显不同。总的规律是：**doing 指已经做过或正在做的事，to do 指接下来要去做的事**。

head: 动词
+ doing
+ to do
rows: 停止正在做的事：He stopped smoking.（戒烟了）
停下来去做另一件事：He stopped to smoke.（停下来抽支烟）
记得做过：I remember locking the door.
记得要去做：Remember to lock the door.
忘记做过：I'll never forget visiting Rome.
忘记要做：I forgot to send the email.
试着做（看看效果）：Try turning it off and on again.
努力设法做：I tried to open the window, but it was stuck.

examples.en: On the way to work, I stopped to buy a coffee.
examples.cn: 上班路上，我停下来买了杯咖啡。

examples.en: I'm sure I've seen this film; I remember watching it with my sister.
examples.cn: 我肯定看过这部电影，我记得是和姐姐一起看的。

examples.en: Don't forget to bring your passport to the exam.
examples.cn: 别忘了考试时带护照。

sections.heading: 动名词作主语
sections.body: 动名词可以作主语，谓语用**单数**。这样写简洁、正式，写作中经常可以和 It is ... to do 结构互换，让句式更多样。

head: 动名词作主语
It ... to do
rows: It takes time to learn a language.
It can be lonely to live abroad.

examples.en: Recycling paper saves trees and energy.
examples.cn: 回收纸张能节约树木和能源。
examples.note: 动名词作主语，谓语 saves 用单数。

examples.en: Reading widely is the best way to improve your vocabulary.
examples.cn: 广泛阅读是扩大词汇量的最好方法。

pitfalls.wrong: I enjoy to read novels.
pitfalls.right: I enjoy reading novels.
pitfalls.why: enjoy 后面只能接动名词。

pitfalls.wrong: I'm looking forward to see you.
pitfalls.right: I'm looking forward to seeing you.
pitfalls.why: look forward to 的 to 是介词，后面接动名词。书信结尾的高频错误。

pitfalls.wrong: She decided studying abroad.
pitfalls.right: She decided to study abroad.
pitfalls.why: decide 后面接 to do。

pitfalls.wrong: He suggested to take a taxi.
pitfalls.right: He suggested taking a taxi.
pitfalls.why: suggest 后面接 doing 或 that 从句，不接 to do。中文「建议做」容易直译成 suggest to do。

pitfalls.wrong: My doctor told me to stop to smoke.
pitfalls.right: My doctor told me to stop smoking.
pitfalls.why: 戒烟是停止正在做的事，用 stop doing；stop to smoke 的意思是停下来去抽烟。

exercises.q: Have you finished ___ your essay?
exercises.explain: finish 后面接动名词。

exercises.q: We can't afford ___ a new car this year.
exercises.explain: afford 后面接 to do。

exercises.q: I was so tired that I stopped ___ (have) a rest halfway up the hill.
answer: to have
exercises.explain: 停下（走路）去做另一件事「休息」，用 stop to do。

exercises.q: I clearly remember ___ (lock) the door, but now it's open!
answer: locking
exercises.explain: 记得已经做过的事，用 remember doing。

exercises.q: Many students avoid to speak English in class.
answer: Many students avoid speaking English in class.
exercises.explain: avoid 后面接动名词。

exercises.q: I look forward to hear from you.
answer: I look forward to hearing from you.
exercises.explain: look forward to 的 to 是介词，后面接动名词 hearing。
